career_sources_key_matches_kind.name: career_sources_key_matches_kind
career_sources_key_matches_kind.value:
("career_sources"."kind" in ('resume', 'cover_letter')) = ("career_sources"."document_version_id" is not null)
        and ("career_sources"."kind" = 'profile') = ("career_sources"."profile_version_id" is not null)
        and ("career_sources"."kind" = 'linkedin') = ("career_sources"."text" is not null)

contacts_job_email_live_idx.name: contacts_job_email_live_idx
contacts_job_email_live_idx.where: "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."email" is not null

outreach_attachments_has_source.name: outreach_attachments_has_source
outreach_attachments_has_source.value: "outreach_attachments"."document_id" is not null or "outreach_attachments"."file_id" is not null
